newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Flowers cover graves of Belgian sex-ring children.
newsitem.headline: Flowers cover graves of Belgian sex-ring children.

text.p: Mourners covered the graves of four young girl victims of a Belgian paedophile ring with thousands of chrysanthemums on Friday to mark All Saints Day.

Hundred of couples, holding hands with their young children and many shedding tears, visited the graveyards where eight-year-old Julie Lejeune and Melissa Russo, and An Marchal, 17, and Eefje Lambrecks, 19, were buried.

They also stood before the houses owned by Marc Dutroux, the man alleged to have run the paedophile ring which kidnapped and murdered them. The child murder and sex scandal has rocked Belgium since the girls' bodies were discovered over the summer.
